text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan is a sight to behold as she
tears
down the track at Nakayama
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She kicks up the dirt with all her might,
pumping
her legs over and over and
speeding up in the
blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The audience is so absorbed they forget
to
breathe. Then, from somewhere in the
crowd...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Holy crap! Aston Machan is insane!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Raaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Aston Machan wins!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Whew...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a second! Isn't Machan still in
her classic
year?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
How the heck can she race like that?!
Just... wow!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Machan! Thank you for the awesomest
race ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thunderous applause and cheers ring
out loud enough to shake the venue. As
Aston Machan gazes up at the stands,
she looks completely
awestruck.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I did it. I really did it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I made my mark! A deep one that will go
down in
history!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look at her now, and all those days we

shared—seemingly peaceful yet
intensely
driven—flash before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Did you s—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wait, are you crying?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's something hot welling up inside
me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...That's understandable. I left a mark on
so many
people's hearts today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And that made you so happy you're
crying tears
of joy, right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Because... that's something that matters
to me?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I... see... Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan looks around as if
searching for
the right words.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to become a super ultra
mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And I'll do whatever it takes to make
that
happen. Which is only natural, since
the dream is
mine.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile you, Trainer, are the lens that
captures me at every angle, and
spreads the word
so that I can realize
that dream.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A passionately diligent lens.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...At least,
I thought that's all you were.
But it
seems...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan looks right at me, and I
see my
face reflected in her big, round
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I was wrong. That's not all, is it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Now I understand even less.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The more I think back, the less I
understand
about you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You do so much for me that goes
beyond the
scope of your job. I wonder
if you're doing too
much for me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if you're too invested. It's
almost like you're making the things
important to me
important to yourself as
well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Normal.
choice_data_list: I thought that was a given, but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Normal." So, basically...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If I were to draw the best picture I've
ever drawn
in my life...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Would it be normal for you to be there
with me,
just as happy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure whether she can tell how
confused I
am. Either way, she continues.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Would it be normal for you to be just as
sad as
me when I lose, or just as happy if
I break a
record?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
When the stands look dazzling and their
cheers are so loud they shake my heart,
it's normal for
you to feel the same as I
do?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Is that what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...
That's... weird.
choice_data_list: I think that's exactly what it means.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's as if...
the two of us are drifting down
the river
together.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's just...
the very idea of it is strange.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
After all... each boat holds only one
person. The
rapids toss you about before
bringing you to the
sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And steering is hard enough as it is. The
chances
of going off course are very
high.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And yet, despite all that, you believe
you'll keep
going down the river with
me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You really believe that's normal?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's asking if I plan to stay beside
her, and
support her until the very end,
then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She blinks at me with wide eyes.
Moments pass in
silence as she tries to
find an answer, until...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Always by my side, taking picture after
picture...
I see. Interesting.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You really are strange, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. You're a real weirdo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then her face relaxes into a relieved
smile.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, Machan will never
disappear as
long as you're around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...After that, Aston Machan says nothing
else
about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still don't think I fully understand
what
she
meant when she said I was strange...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I do get the sense that the frantic 
undercurrent she's been hiding inside
her—that pushes her recklessly
onward—has eased up
somewhat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we're heading back to campus, Aston
Machan
gives me a present.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is the Machan doll prototype 3.0.
It's about
time I gave it to you. I hope
you can make do
with this for now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The doll she hands me has more heft to
it than I
expected.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Once I get them properly licensed by
the URA, I'll
give you another. You'll be
the very first to have
one.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not giving you the first one just
because
you're my trainer, by the way.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's because you're you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've realized something. I think you
should hold
on to it...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I think that's safest.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As usual, her true intentions escape me,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll take this as a sign that she's
acknowledged me
as her trainer.
choice_data_list: Thanks, I'll take good care of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I reposition the doll so I can carry it
safely in both
hands.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I almost forgot. About my next
race...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. That should be a given.
choice_data_list: Is there one you want to run in?
Is there one you'd like to run in?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My next race is the grand senior-year
sprint, the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If I can do well there,
then I'm sure I'll be
able to
give you an official doll one day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Of course.
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's do our best together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
Spring is
on its way again.
